Reconstruct the visible indoor scene from one RGB photograph using SceneAct and Blender.
Infer geometry and a camera matching the reference viewpoint, perspective and framing.
Use separate 3D meshes for architecture, furniture and visible objects, preserving colors,
proportions, placement, occlusions and materials. Do not use the reference as a texture,
background or projected image. No ground-truth calibration or other views are available.

Return a complete, runnable Python program inside one ```python code block. Each execution
starts in a fresh Blender process. Programs can use numpy, sceneact and bpy. Use SceneAct
for geometry and relationships; bpy may customize lighting, materials and camera settings.
Do not render or save files in the program: the fixed runner saves and renders once after
execution, using your active camera. Do not access external files, network or other models.
When satisfied after inspecting a rendering, reply exactly DONE. The last successful build
is submitted automatically. Budget includes all planning, corrections and review calls.

SceneAct API (all coordinates in a world frame with Z up; angles in degrees):
from sceneact import *
Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)
parent.include(name, node) attaches an asset/part while preserving its world position.
parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)
rod(radius, start=(x,y,z), end=(x,y,z), color=(1,1,1))
rod(radius, length=h, center=(0,0,0), axis='+z', color=(1,1,1))
fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

Example:
from sceneact import *
scene = Scene()
table = Asset('table')
table.include('top', box((1.4,.8,.08), center=(0,0,.75), color=(.4,.2,.1)))
for x in (-.6,.6):
    for y in (-.3,.3):
        table.include(f'leg_{x}_{y}', box((.07,.07,.7), center=(x,y,.35)))
scene.include('table', table)
scene.include('floor', box((6,6,.1), center=(0,0,-.05), color=(.6,.6,.6)))
realize(scene)
set_view((3,-4,2), (0,0,.7), lens=40)
area_emitter((0,-2,4), power=1000)

```python
from sceneact import *
import bpy, math, random
from mathutils import Vector
random.seed(18)

scene = Scene("Victorian bedroom")
cream=(.81,.79,.69)
wood=(.075,.037,.023)
gold=(.55,.34,.10)
olive=(.24,.25,.045)

def add(name,node):
    scene.include(name,node)
    return node

def ell(name,center,scale,color):
    n=ball(1,center=center,color=color)
    n.resize(scale)
    return add(name,n)

# Room shell, open toward the viewer.
add("stone floor",box((8.2,9,.13),center=(0,0,-.085),color=(.61,.59,.52)))
add("back patterned wall",box((7.6,.16,3.55),center=(-.3,3.65,1.775),color=(.39,.29,.18)))
add("right patterned wall",box((.16,8.5,3.55),center=(3.45,-.5,1.775),color=(.39,.29,.18)))
add("back baseboard",box((7.6,.07,.17),center=(-.3,3.52,.085),color=(.27,.21,.15)))
add("right baseboard",box((.07,8.5,.17),center=(3.32,-.5,.085),color=(.27,.21,.15)))
for z,depth,height in [(3.38,.16,.12),(3.47,.24,.08),(3.53,.32,.06)]:
    add("back crown"+str(z),box((7.7,depth,height),center=(-.3,3.51,z),color=(.91,.91,.86)))
    add("right crown"+str(z),box((depth,8.5,height),center=(3.32,-.5,z),color=(.91,.91,.86)))
add("ceiling",box((7.7,8.5,.10),center=(-.3,-.5,3.61),color=(.86,.87,.84)))

# Two tall sash windows.
for i,x in enumerate([-3.00,-.98]):
    add("window recess"+str(i),box((1.35,.06,2.66),center=(x,3.535,1.86),color=(.88,.91,.89)))
    add("daylight glass"+str(i),box((1.12,.035,2.39),center=(x,3.485,1.87),color=(.79,.92,.92)))
    for xx in [x-.68,x+.68]:
        add("window architrave",box((.11,.15,2.83),center=(xx,3.43,1.86),color=(.94,.93,.87)))
        add("inner sash edge",box((.045,.07,2.57),center=(xx+(.10 if xx<x else -.10),3.37,1.86),color=(.79,.82,.78)))
    for zz in [.47,3.25]:
        add("window horizontal trim",box((1.47,.16,.11),center=(x,3.43,zz),color=(.96,.94,.88)))
    add("sash crossbar",box((1.2,.085,.045),center=(x,3.37,1.43),color=(.86,.88,.81)))
    add("window sill",box((1.52,.30,.075),center=(x,3.35,.48),color=(.91,.89,.81)))
    # Green fabric roller shades cover the upper glass.
    add("green roller blind"+str(i),box((1.09,.035,1.25),center=(x,3.32,2.47),color=(.16,.34,.29)))
    add("blind bottom hem"+str(i),rod(.014,start=(x-.55,3.29,1.845),end=(x+.55,3.29,1.845),color=(.30,.43,.36)))

# Narrow white door in the rear corner.
add("door frame",box((.79,.10,2.35),center=(1.23,3.48,1.175),color=(.89,.89,.81)))
add("door slab",box((.65,.07,2.23),center=(1.23,3.40,1.15),color=(.79,.82,.77)))
for z,h in [(.65,.76),(1.67,.90)]:
    add("door inset",box((.49,.025,h),center=(1.23,3.35,z),color=(.85,.87,.82)))
add("door knob",ball(.032,center=(1.48,3.29,1.08),color=gold))

# Bed extends out from the right wall.
bed=Asset("dark mahogany sleigh bed")
bed.include("frame",box((2.66,1.80,.27),center=(1.94,.34,.36),color=wood))
bed.include("mattress",fillet_box((2.53,1.67,.27),radius=.12,center=(1.92,.34,.62),color=(.72,.72,.63)))
bed.include("white coverlet",fillet_box((2.46,1.69,.18),radius=.15,center=(1.88,.32,.77),color=(.84,.83,.73)))
# The footboard at the nearer left end.
bed.include("foot panel",box((.11,1.88,.70),center=(.56,.34,.57),color=wood))
bed.include("footboard cap",rod(.065,start=(.55,-.65,.97),end=(.55,1.33,.97),color=(.11,.061,.032)))
for yy in [-.61,1.29]:
    bed.include("foot post"+str(yy),box((.15,.15,1.02),center=(.54,yy,.53),color=wood))
    bed.include("post rounded top"+str(yy),ball(.10,center=(.54,yy,1.06),color=wood))
    bed.include("head post"+str(yy),box((.13,.13,1.31),center=(3.22,yy,.68),color=wood))
bed.include("head board",box((.13,1.85,1.02),center=(3.21,.34,.85),color=wood))
bed.include("head upper rail",rod(.065,start=(3.20,-.65,1.40),end=(3.20,1.33,1.40),color=(.11,.061,.033)))
for xx in [.69,3.08]:
    for yy in [-.49,1.17]:
        bed.include("bed leg",box((.13,.13,.30),center=(xx,yy,.16),color=wood))
scene.include("bed",bed)

# Two large soft pillows leaning against the headboard.
for i,yy in enumerate([-.12,.77]):
    p=fillet_box((.64,.77,.25),radius=.12,center=(2.76,yy,1.04),color=(.89,.88,.79))
    p.turn('y',-29)
    add("plump pillow "+str(i),p)
    # Underlying pillow gives a rumpled silhouette.
    q=fillet_box((.68,.79,.10),radius=.07,center=(2.86,yy,.91),color=(.76,.76,.68))
    q.turn('y',-18)
    add("pillow under edge "+str(i),q)

# Fine coverlet wrinkles, close in tone to the fabric.
for i in range(24):
    xx=random.uniform(.78,2.48)
    yy=random.uniform(-.39,1.08)
    pts=[(xx+j*.055,yy+math.sin(j*.65+i)*.016,.866+math.sin(j*.7)*.007) for j in range(random.randint(3,7))]
    add("linen crease"+str(i),sweep_tube(points=pts,radius=.0035,color=(.75,.75,.66)))

# Upholstered tub chair in the foreground, slightly turned.
chair=Asset("olive velvet armchair")
def cp(name,n):
    chair.include(name,n)
def ce(name,c,s,col):
    n=ball(1,center=c,color=col);n.resize(s);cp(name,n)
cp("lower upholstered body",fillet_box((1.23,1.09,.48),radius=.20,center=(-.65,-.22,.45),color=(.24,.25,.035)))
ce("rounded tall back",(-.65,.20,1.00),(.59,.20,.69),(.29,.30,.055))
ce("back inner cushion",(-.65,.027,1.04),(.46,.09,.52),(.34,.35,.066))
ce("seat cushion",(-.65,-.38,.70),(.49,.48,.14),(.36,.36,.063))
for xx in [-1.20,-.10]:
    ce("curved arm side"+str(xx),(xx,-.24,.70),(.14,.57,.43),(.23,.24,.035))
    cp("rolled arm"+str(xx),sweep_tube(points=[(xx,.17,1.13),(xx,-.05,1.05),(xx,-.32,.93),(xx,-.61,.87),(xx,-.75,.84)],radius=.065,color=(.32,.32,.060)))
for xx in [-1.10,-.20]:
    for yy in [-.63,.18]:
        cp("small wooden foot",rod(.035,start=(xx,yy,.05),end=(xx,yy,.30),color=(.13,.09,.035)))
# Button tufting.
for zz,xs in [(1.29,[-.88,-.62,-.36]),(1.06,[-1.0,-.75,-.49,-.25]),(.84,[-.87,-.61,-.35])]:
    for xx in xs:
        ce("velvet button",(xx,-.065,zz),(.025,.018,.024),(.18,.20,.025))
        cp("tuft fold",sweep_tube(points=[(xx-.07,-.057,zz+.09),(xx,-.083,zz),(xx+.065,-.057,zz-.09)],radius=.009,color=(.24,.26,.035)))
chair.turn('z',-15,pivot=(-.65,-.22,0))
scene.include("chair",chair)

# Three folding panels painted blue and gold.
for k in range(3):
    x=-.05+k*.48
    y=2.46+( .08 if k==1 else 0)
    add("screen panel"+str(k),box((.49,.055,1.74),center=(x,y,1.18),color=(.60,.44,.19)))
    for xx in [x-.24,x+.24]:
        add("screen edge",rod(.012,start=(xx,y-.035,.30),end=(xx,y-.035,2.06),color=(.17,.12,.05)))
    add("screen top",rod(.012,start=(x-.24,y-.035,2.055),end=(x+.24,y-.035,2.055),color=(.17,.12,.05)))
    # Stylized painted flowing cobalt shapes.
    for j in range(3):
        zz=.56+j*.47
        n=ball(1,center=(x+random.uniform(-.12,.12),y-.036,zz),color=(.018,.075,.40))
        n.resize((.25,.014,.19))
        n.turn('y',random.uniform(-40,40))
        add("blue painted cloud",n)
    add("blue serpentine motif",sweep_tube(points=[(x-.20,y-.059,.42),(x+.12,y-.059,.79),(x-.10,y-.059,1.11),(x+.17,y-.059,1.44),(x+.13,y-.059,1.91)],radius=.060,color=(.025,.10,.43)))
    for j in range(8):
        zz=random.uniform(.42,1.96)
        add("painted gold fleck",ball(.016,center=(x+random.uniform(-.20,.20),y-.083,zz),color=(.78,.61,.26)))

# Writing cabinet at far left.
add("antique chest",box((1.04,.47,.65),center=(-3.07,2.99,.54),color=(.105,.061,.033)))
add("chest top",box((1.12,.55,.07),center=(-3.07,2.98,.90),color=(.17,.10,.055)))
for xx in [-3.51,-2.63]:
    for yy in [2.79,3.17]:
        add("cabinet turned leg",rod(.035,start=(xx,yy,.05),end=(xx,yy,.29),color=wood))
for zz in [.42,.67]:
    add("drawer line",box((.95,.018,.016),center=(-3.07,2.743,zz),color=(.04,.025,.018)))
    for xx in [-3.32,-2.83]:
        add("brass drawer pull",ball(.027,center=(xx,2.72,zz+.08),color=gold))
# Small framed tabletop picture.
add("small frame",box((.28,.05,.37),center=(-3.13,2.98,1.12),color=gold))
add("small picture",box((.22,.018,.30),center=(-3.13,2.943,1.12),color=(.075,.085,.056)))

# Small round draped table between windows.
tx,ty=-1.98,2.92
add("tea table top",rod(.36,length=.055,center=(tx,ty,.88),color=(.28,.17,.075)))
for dx,dy in [(-.21,-.17),(.21,-.17),(0,.22)]:
    add("tea table leg",rod(.022,start=(tx+dx,ty+dy,.06),end=(tx+dx*.55,ty+dy*.55,.86),color=wood))
# Triangular cloth draped over the top, made from a white mesh after realization.
for xx in [tx-.16,tx+.11]:
    add("tea cup",rod(.048,length=.065,center=(xx,ty-.04,.955),color=(.85,.82,.66)))
    add("saucer",rod(.072,length=.012,center=(xx,ty-.04,.914),color=(.88,.85,.73)))
add("little pot",ball(.065,center=(tx+.03,ty+.10,.98),color=(.78,.72,.48)))
add("wastebasket",rod(.105,length=.24,center=(-2.43,3.12,.12),color=(.26,.13,.065)))

# Wall pictures, including the distinctive oval portrait.
def back_frame(name,x,z,w,h,oval=False):
    if oval:
        n=ball(1,center=(x,3.48,z),color=(.67,.45,.16));n.resize((w/2,.052,h/2));add(name+" outer",n)
        n=ball(1,center=(x,3.417,z),color=(.85,.67,.28));n.resize((w/2-.045,.021,h/2-.045));add(name+" inner",n)
        n=ball(1,center=(x,3.388,z),color=(.042,.031,.025));n.resize((w/2-.075,.014,h/2-.075));add(name+" canvas",n)
        ell(name+" face",(x,3.363,z+.10),(.073,.012,.096),(.40,.26,.15))
        ell(name+" coat",(x,3.363,z-.12),(.17,.014,.19),(.035,.029,.024))
        add(name+" collar",box((.08,.015,.035),center=(x+.01,3.341,z-.015),color=(.69,.63,.49)))
    else:
        add(name+" frame",box((w,.055,h),center=(x,3.46,z),color=(.63,.48,.25)))
        add(name+" mat",box((w-.045,.018,h-.045),center=(x,3.42,z),color=(.85,.82,.70)))
        add(name+" image",box((w*.62,.012,h*.70),center=(x,3.40,z),color=(.46,.45,.39)))
        ell(name+" portrait",(x,3.387,z+.025),(w*.18,.009,h*.23),(.28,.29,.26))
back_frame("oval ancestral portrait",-1.98,2.45,.78,.98,True)
back_frame("small monochrome print",.49,2.65,.44,.60)
# Print on right wall.
add("right wall picture frame",box((.055,.40,.59),center=(3.32,2.15,2.62),color=(.65,.47,.22)))
add("right wall picture mat",box((.019,.35,.54),center=(3.28,2.15,2.62),color=(.84,.80,.68)))
n=ball(1,center=(3.263,2.15,2.62),color=(.44,.40,.32));n.resize((.012,.10,.19));add("oval print",n)

# Slender side chair near the far side of the bed.
for xx in [1.70,2.12]:
    for yy in [2.04,2.46]:
        add("side chair leg",rod(.022,start=(xx,yy,.02),end=(xx,yy,.57),color=wood))
add("side chair seat",box((.49,.48,.055),center=(1.91,2.25,.58),color=(.20,.16,.10)))
for xx in [1.68,2.14]:
    add("side chair back upright",rod(.022,start=(xx,2.46,.56),end=(xx,2.46,1.18),color=wood))
add("side chair crest",rod(.035,start=(1.66,2.46,1.18),end=(2.16,2.46,1.18),color=wood))
for xx in [1.78,1.90,2.02]:
    add("side chair spindle",rod(.012,start=(xx,2.46,.64),end=(xx,2.46,1.15),color=wood))
# Dark circular bedside table partially cropped.
add("round bedside top",rod(.43,length=.075,center=(3.30,-1.15,.67),color=(.065,.038,.026)))
add("round bedside pedestal",rod(.12,length=.55,center=(3.30,-1.15,.32),color=wood))
add("round bedside foot",rod(.34,length=.075,center=(3.30,-1.15,.06),color=wood))

# Flat oriental rugs.
def rug(name,cx,cy,w,h):
    add(name,box((w,h,.013),center=(cx,cy,.006),color=(.38,.16,.10)))
    for k,col in enumerate([(.68,.49,.27),(.17,.23,.24),(.66,.44,.24),(.28,.12,.08)]):
        inset=.025+k*.042
        for sy in [-1,1]:
            add(name+" border",box((w-2*inset,.024,.005),center=(cx,cy+sy*(h/2-inset),.016),color=col))
        for sx in [-1,1]:
            add(name+" border",box((.024,h-2*inset,.005),center=(cx+sx*(w/2-inset),cy,.016),color=col))
    for ix in range(7):
        for iy in range(5):
            xx=cx+(ix-3)*(w-.38)/7
            yy=cy+(iy-2)*(h-.35)/5
            q=box((.072,.072,.004),center=(xx,yy,.019),color=(.64,.46,.26))
            q.turn('z',45);add(name+" woven motif",q)
rug("rear Persian rug",-1.12,1.57,1.72,.89)
rug("foreground rug",1.59,-1.48,2.27,.93)

realize(scene)

# A physically shaded procedural wallpaper gives the dense historic floral texture.
wallmat=bpy.data.materials.new("ochre and faded blue floral wallpaper")
wallmat.use_nodes=True
nt=wallmat.node_tree
bs=nt.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.92
tex=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
noise=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value=83
noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value=3
noise.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.76
nt.links.new(tex.outputs["Generated"],noise.inputs["Vector"])
ramp=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
ramp.color_ramp.elements.remove(ramp.color_ramp.elements[1])
for i,(pos,col) in enumerate([
    (.20,(.11,.12,.105,1)),(.36,(.25,.25,.19,1)),(.48,(.43,.29,.16,1)),
    (.58,(.57,.40,.23,1)),(.73,(.30,.29,.23,1)),(.85,(.64,.46,.27,1))]):
    el=ramp.color_ramp.elements[0] if i==0 else ramp.color_ramp.elements.new(pos)
    el.position=pos;el.color=col
nt.links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"],ramp.inputs["Fac"])
nt.links.new(ramp.outputs["Color"],bs.inputs["Base Color"])
bump=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump");bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value=.17;bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value=.016
nt.links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
nt.links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"],bs.inputs["Normal"])
for ob in bpy.data.objects:
    if ob.type=='MESH' and "patterned wall" in ob.name:
        ob.data.materials.clear();ob.data.materials.append(wallmat)

# Repeating small leafy flourishes over the paper, placed in wall coordinates.
patternmat=bpy.data.materials.new("faded floral ink")
patternmat.diffuse_color=(.23,.25,.20,1)
verts=[];faces=[]
def leaf(x,y,z,sx,sz,wall):
    b=len(verts)
    if wall=="back":
        verts.extend([(x-sx,y,z),(x,y,z+sz),(x+sx,y,z),(x,y,z-sz)])
    else:
        verts.extend([(x,y-sx,z),(x,y,z+sz),(x,y+sx,z),(x,y,z-sz)])
    faces.append((b,b+1,b+2,b+3))
for row in range(36):
    z=.20+row*.088
    for col in range(75):
        x=-4.0+col*.102+(row%2)*.051
        # Leave the window and door regions uncovered.
        occupied=any(abs(x-wx)<.76 and .42<z<3.3 for wx in [-3,-.98]) or (abs(x-1.23)<.44 and z<2.4)
        if not occupied:
            leaf(x,3.558,z,.014,.028,"back")
            leaf(x+.024,3.557,z+.021,.011,.017,"back")
    for col in range(88):
        yy=-4.45+col*.102+(row%2)*.051
        leaf(3.362,yy,z,.014,.028,"right")
        leaf(3.361,yy+.024,z+.021,.011,.017,"right")
mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new("wallpaper repeating leaf mesh");mesh.from_pydata(verts,[],faces);mesh.materials.append(patternmat)
ob=bpy.data.objects.new("tiny repeated wallpaper leaves",mesh);bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)

# White cloth with a hanging point.
mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new("tea cloth mesh")
mesh.from_pydata([(tx-.38,ty-.28,.925),(tx+.38,ty-.28,.925),(tx+.34,ty+.24,.925),(tx-.34,ty+.24,.925),(tx,ty-.38,.48)],[],[(0,1,2,3),(0,4,1)])
mesh.materials.append(bpy.data.materials.new("ivory cloth"))
mesh.materials[0].diffuse_color=(.88,.87,.79,1)
ob=bpy.data.objects.new("draped white tablecloth",mesh);bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
sol=ob.modifiers.new("cloth thickness","SOLIDIFY");sol.thickness=.004

# Slightly uneven, matte stone floor.
floormat=bpy.data.materials.new("old pale stone");floormat.use_nodes=True
nt=floormat.node_tree;bs=nt.nodes.get("Principled BSDF");bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.87
noise=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise");noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value=5;noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value=4
r=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB");r.color_ramp.elements[0].color=(.39,.39,.34,1);r.color_ramp.elements[1].color=(.72,.70,.61,1)
```
